niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, premium-feeling mobile UI with calm restrained styling: spacious layouts, soft rounded surfaces, muted blue/gray or navy-green palettes, strong but clean hierarchy, guided onboarding with explicit progress and anchored CTAs, and warm human/editorial framing when imagery is used. Generally favors fewer competing modules, clearer grouping, softer contrast, and supportive/reassuring tone over loud, busy, highly promotional, or harsh utility-heavy presentations.

criteria.description: Prefers airy layouts with breathing room, slower pacing, and fewer competing elements on screen at once.
Prefers polished, premium, device-native/editorial visual execution over generic, template-like, or utilitarian UI.
Prefers onboarding and task flows that feel explicitly guided, with clear step framing, narrative progression, and obvious next actions.
Prefers softer surfaces, rounded cards/panels, gentle shadows, and less rigid or harsh component treatment.
Prefers muted, restrained palettes with controlled blue/gray/navy accents rather than loud, highly saturated, multicolor, or aggressive contrast accents.
Prefers a clear visual hierarchy with one dominant focal area, stronger emphasis, and less fragmentation from many equal-weight sections.
Prefers information organized into fewer, larger, clearly grouped sections rather than fragmented stacks of many small modules.
Prefers calm, supportive, welcoming, and reassuring presentation over harsh, alarmist, clinical, or overly procedural tone.
Prefers a clearly anchored primary action and directed progression, especially through strong bottom CTA treatment and reduced decision friction.
